verified: edh-cast-15 review (Commander lane edh-cast; held-out, opened by the owner (commander request 2026-10-27), EDHREC rank 4603), by hand against the Oracle text and the Scryfall rulings: (rid.edhc15.mana.whenSpent.castOrActivate.copy) the mana the ability adds carries the triggered ability (CR 106.6, 603.2, 602.2): it triggers when the mana is spent to cast a spell or to activate an ability that uses the stack, copies that spell or ability (CR 707.10, 707.10c: new targets by rid.copy.newTargets reaching into the trigger); it is still a mana ability (CR 605.1a: the words 'new targets' of the copy are not a target of the ability). Rulings 2024-06-07: the copy is created on the stack, not cast or activated; a mana ability is never copied (it uses no stack). The first two abilities were automated before.

edh-cast-15 review (Commander lane edh-cast; tuning, EDHREC rank 4762), by hand against the Oracle text and the Scryfall rulings: (eff.edhc15.copy.all.spells.thenOtherAbilities) copy every spell I control on the stack, then every other activated and triggered ability I control (CR 707.10, 113.7a: all other = not the ability being resolved), and 'the copies' of both get new targets (rid.t45.copy.newTargets.plural, @withPrevious). Rulings 2024-06-07: copies are not cast or activated; mana abilities are not copied; modes, X and divisions stay. Devoid and the pay {C}{C} trigger were automated before.

edh-cast-15 review (Commander lane edh-cast; tuning, EDHREC rank 4737), by hand against the Oracle text and the Scryfall rulings: exile the target instant or sorcery card, then a delayed trigger that lasts the turn copies the exiled card each time a creature I control deals combat damage to a player and I may cast the copy without paying its mana cost (rid.r4copy.mayCastCopy.free through the delay, @into; CR 707.12, 603.7, 601.2, 118.9). Rulings 2021-04-16: the copy is cast while the delayed trigger resolves, X is 0, additional costs are paid. The pump of +X/+0 was automated before.

edh-cast-15 review (Commander lane edh-cast; held-out, opened by the owner (commander request 2026-10-27), EDHREC rank 4962), by hand against the Oracle text and the Scryfall rulings: (eff.edhc15.eachOpponentMay.copy.newTargets) (eff.edhc15.copy.oncePlus.eachOpponentWhoCopied) (rid.edhc15.copies.youControl.newTargets) the target spell (not itself, CR 115.5); each opponent in turn may copy it and may choose new targets for their copy; then I copy it once plus once for each opponent who did (resultCount of the may step); my copies are put on the stack last and resolve first (ruling 2024-06-07); CR 707.10, 707.10c, 608.2d, 101.4.

edh-cast-15 review (Commander lane edh-cast; tuning, EDHREC rank 1151), by hand against the Oracle text and the Scryfall rulings: (cm.edhc15.additional.sacrificeOneOrMore.copyForEach) the optional additional cost 'sacrifice one or more creatures' announced as a number (0 is not paying it) and the reflexive 'when you do, copy this spell for each creature sacrificed this way' (CR 118.8, 601.2b, 603.12, 707.10); the copies keep the spell's choices. The draw and 1 life loss were automated before. Rulings 2021-04-16 (magecraft) concern other cards' triggers.

edh-cast-15 review (Commander lane edh-cast; tuning, EDHREC rank 2285), by hand against the Oracle text and the Scryfall rulings: (sta.edhc15.spells.cast.ripple) a layer 6 grant of ripple 4 to every spell I cast (not copies, CR 707.10); ripple (keywords/data/ripple.json, CR 702.60a): when I cast the spell I may reveal the top 4 cards, may cast any spells with the same name from among them without paying their mana costs (a spell cast this way has ripple too, so it ripples again), and the rest go on the bottom in any order of my choice.

edh-cast-15 review (Commander lane edh-cast; tuning, EDHREC rank 2376), by hand against the Oracle text and the Scryfall rulings: (cm.edhc15.self.less.ifTargetsSpellThatTargets) the cost reduction of {7} when the spell or ability it targets targets a creature I control with power 7 or greater (CR 601.2f, 118.7, 115.9b): the power belongs to the creature, not to the spell or ability; judged as the spell is cast with the current targets of the targeted spell (rulings 2010-06-15). The counter ability was automated before.

edh-cast-15 review (Commander lane edh-cast; tuning, EDHREC rank 2467), by hand against the Oracle text and the Scryfall rulings: (eff.edhc15.choose.anotherTargetPlayer.thanCaster) 'choose another target player' in the first-spell trigger: any player but the one who cast the spell (CR 115.1), judged again as the trigger resolves (CR 608.2b); the caster is never a legal choice, so with two players I must target myself when my opponent casts their first spell (ruling 2024-09-20); damage equal to that spell's mana value (X counts); menace and 'your opponents can't gain life' were automated before.

edh-cast-15 review (Commander lane edh-cast; tuning, EDHREC rank 4240), by hand against the Oracle text and the Scryfall rulings: (eff.edhc15.owner.putsIt.topOrBottom) up to one target creature spell or planeswalker spell (a target list of two spell descriptions on the stack, never a permanent: ruling 2021-06-18), its owner chooses the top or the bottom of their library; the spell does not resolve and is not countered (CR 401.4, 400.3, 608.2d). Flash, flying and evoke were automated before.

edh-cast-15 review (Commander lane edh-cast; tuning, EDHREC rank 4539), by hand against the Oracle text and the Scryfall rulings: 'it' and 'that card' are the card exiled from the top of my library, not the dying creature (CR 608.2c, 400.7): if it is a Goblin creature card I may cast it until the end of my next turn (a permit from exile with endOfNextTurn). Triggers once for each Goblin that dies at the same time (ruling 2022-09-09). The anthem 'Other Goblins you control get +1/+1' was automated before.

edh-cast-15 review (Commander lane edh-cast; tuning, EDHREC rank 4099), by hand against the Oracle text and the Scryfall rulings: (eff.edhc15.cast.upTo.instantSorcery.totalMV.graveyardOrHand.free) (rid.edhc15.cast.those.exileInstead) up to two instant and/or sorcery cards from my graveyard and/or hand with total mana value 6 or less, cast one after the other without paying their mana costs (CR 601.2, 608.2d, 118.9, 202.3), exiled instead of going to my graveyard (CR 614.1a), then the spell itself is exiled. Rulings 2022-02-18: the second spell cast resolves first; X is 0; additional costs are paid. Known limit (fail closed, under-offers): the mana value and types are read from the cards, not the spells, so the back face of a modal double-faced card and a split card's single half are not offered.

edh-cast-15 review (Commander lane edh-cast; held-out, opened by the owner (commander request 2026-10-27), EDHREC rank 3155), by hand against the Oracle text and the Scryfall rulings: (eff.edhc15.cantBeCounteredOrTargeted.byBlueOrBlackSpells.thisTurn) two rules for the rest of the turn on the spells and creatures I control at any time (CR 701.6a, 115.1, 101.2): blue or black SPELLS can't counter my spells or target my creatures (abilities can; the Veil itself can still be countered; rulings 2010-08-15). Judged again as a spell resolves (CR 608.2b).
